title: Week of June 22–28
subtitle: Week 2 · Progression — targets set. One quality run (Tue); everything else easy. Easy flush jog after each lift.
goals: Hit the suggested weights at RPE 8 on the main lifts — small jumps, clean reps
ONE hard run (Tuesday) — open it up; keep every other run easy (HR ≤150)
Finish each lift day with a 1–1.5 mi easy flush jog — no more hard post-lift miles
review: Calibration done, and it was a strong, consistent week — 6 sessions, every baseline logged, and weight already moving 202.9 → 199 lb (on pace for 189.9 by Aug 14). Lifts looked good — Squat 185×5, Bench 175×5, OHP 105×8, Deadlift 245×4 (felt Great), Row to 135, Pulldown to 130 — so Week 2 now carries suggested weights on every main lift; chase the targets at RPE 8. The fix this week is running: last week 86% of your run time was Zone 3–5 (only 14% easy). So we polarize — Tuesday is your ONE hard 'release' run (push into Zone 4 and enjoy it), and every other run stays genuinely easy (HR ≤150), including a short easy flush jog to finish each lift day. Hard day hard, easy days easy — that's what actually builds the base while protecting your lifting in the deficit.
